free_tier.stated: No published per-wiki storage cap; per-file ceiling is 100 MB (live siteinfo). Free, ad-supported; paid tiers exist for custom domains.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: No egress meter; images served from `images.shoutwiki.com`.

tooling: Standard MediaWiki Action API (1.43.6) + Pywikibot. No rclone backend.
chaining: 100 MB/file x unlimited files x unlimited free wikis. Per-file cap is 10x Fandom's.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: 100 MB (104,857,600 B, from siteinfo). request-rate: the wiki HTML and the Action API are behind an Anubis proof-of-work challenge. A POST to `/w/api.php` returned the 'Making sure you're not a bot!' page instead of JSON, so programmatic access needs a PoW-capable client. Retention: no expiry published.
reliability_note: Read path splits: the file CDN (`images.shoutwiki.com`) answers plainly (probe: 200, 12,472 B, real PNG 150x150) while the API is Anubis-gated. Browse/upload programmatically is the blocker, not retrieval.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
